verdict: Ads are running; zero leads recorded — tracking is the problem, not performance.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, $613.56 was spent across Google Ads, generating 128 clicks and 652 website sessions — but zero leads are showing in the system. The data indicates this is a tracking gap, not an ads failure: 136 new opportunities were created in the intake pipeline during the same window, meaning people are coming through, but the connection between ad clicks and your CRM is not firing and those contacts are going unattributed. Conversion tracking is being repaired so that every lead arriving from ads is properly recorded going forward. Separately, your Google Business Profile saw a sharp drop in engagement this week, and that is being investigated alongside the broader attribution fix. The end-to-end stack re-test scheduled for August 31 is the next concrete milestone, and offline conversion import is on track for September 30 — once those are live, the reported numbers will reflect what is actually happening in your pipeline.
